desc: Parse input robustly from stdin: read N, then scan remaining bytes for '0'/'1' to fill leaf DP arrays without creating many tokens.
Initialize dp0 and dp1 for leaves: dp0[i]=0/dp1[i]=1 for '0', dp0[i]=1/dp1[i]=0 for '1'.

Implement in-place level reduction: for each triple, compute new cost0 and cost1 as the sum of the two smallest corresponding child costs, writing into the front of the same arrays and updating the current length.
Run the reduction until one node remains and output max(dp0[0], dp1[0]).
Verify the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases (N=1 all same, N=1 mixed, larger N) for correctness and performance.
